info.title: PyMC Marketing Foundational Models HTTP API
info.description: Upload a weekly history, run an analysis and read the result. Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Error bodies are `{"error": {"code", "message", "request_id", "field"?}}`; the 409 `not_ready` body also has a top-level `status`.

AnalysisCreate.description:
The body of `POST /v1/analyses`: exactly one of three forms. Each needs one data source
(`dataset_id` or `history`) and either a `plan` or `context` with `query`. `null` is accepted
only where the schema says so.

request.description: The request as the service stored it. Its keys are not a stable contract.

AnalysisExport.description: The whole analysis as one document.

next_cursor.description: Only with `limit` or `cursor`. The `cursor` of the next page, null on the last.

AnalysisPreview.description: What an analysis would run. Nothing is stored.

table.description: One row for each plan and component. With `compact=true`, compact rows.

plans.description: Only with `compact=true`: what the rows of each plan share, by plan id.

fit.description: Null for a plan, and before the baseline run is done.

input_usage.description: Null before the baseline run is done.

AnalysisResult.description: The result of an analysis whose runs have all ended.

url.description: The result page, or null when the service has no site address.

runs_cancelled.description: Runs that never started because the baseline failed.

Band.description: A mean and its 5th and 95th percentiles over draws. Each is null when not finite.

draws_url.description: A signed link to the plan's draws file (netCDF4), or null.

CompactPlan.description: What the rows of one plan share, in a compact result.

CompactRow.description:
The numbers of one plan and component. A key of `CompactPlan` appears only where the
row differs from its plan.

values.description: The control value of each forecast week.

levels.description: Each level multiplies the spend of the channel in the window.

value.description: Null where the level was not asked or its run failed.

DatasetCreate.description: The body of `POST /v1/datasets`, and the inline `history` of `POST /v1/analyses`. Limits: the body is at most 5 MB. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`, oldest first, exactly 7 days apart, in the years 1900 to 2199, at least one week. Dates are weekly and may fall on any weekday, but every date must use the same weekday and no week may be missing. Use 1 to 10 spend channels and 1 to 10 controls; at least one control is required. A channel or control name is 1 to 64 characters and unique across both.

outcome_name.description: A label for the site. Not part of the content hash.

currency.description: ISO 4217 shape. Not part of the content hash.

dates.description: Weekly ISO dates, oldest first, exactly 7 days apart. Any weekday works. Years 1900 to 2199.

outcome.description: One positive value for each date.

spend.description: One array of spend for each channel, 0 or more per week. 1 to 10 channels.

controls.description: One array for each control. 1 to 10 controls. At least one control is required.

next_cursor.description: Only with `limit` or `cursor`. The `cursor` of the next page, null on the last.

expires_at.description: Moves later when an analysis uses the dataset.

analyses.description: The number of live analyses of the dataset.

status.description: `ok`, or the run status of a plan without numbers.

failure_code.description: Why this plan has no result; `null` when it did not fail. `worker_stopped`: the service stopped the run, so send the analysis again. `plan_outside_limits`: the plan is outside what the model accepts, so change the plan. `data_unusable`: the model refused the input values, so check the history and plan values. `cancelled`: the run was cancelled, so start it again if you still want it. `unknown`: the service gives no reason, so send it again, and if it fails again quote the `request_id`. To send a failed analysis again, use a new `Idempotency-Key`: the same key returns the failed analysis.

r2.description: Null when the outcome never changes.

shares.description: Null on runs scored before shares were kept.

HistoryBand.description: The weekly 5th percentile, 95th percentile and maximum of a series.

zero_share.description: The share of weeks with a value of 0.

HistoryRange.description: The history of one channel or control.

Labels.description: How to read the numbers. Quote them when you share a result.

PlanFormInline.description: The plan form on an inline dataset: a `history` and a `plan`.

decision_weeks.description: `[i, j]`, 1-based and inclusive, in the plan or in the predicted weeks. Default: all of them.

explain_history.description: Default `true` for a backtest and `false` for a plan.

preview.description: `true` returns the expanded plans and stores nothing.

plan.description: The baseline for the weeks after the history.

history.description: An inline dataset, stored with the analysis.

dataset_id.description: Leave it out, or send null.

decision_weeks.description: `[i, j]`, 1-based and inclusive, in the plan or in the predicted weeks. Default: all of them.

explain_history.description: Default `true` for a backtest and `false` for a plan.

preview.description: `true` returns the expanded plans and stores nothing.

plan.description: The baseline for the weeks after the history.

history.description: Leave it out, or send null.

spend.description: The baseline spend of the channel in the predicted weeks.

ResultMeta.description: The run record: seed, draws, shared run settings and host facts.

base_scenario_id.description: The plan the difference is measured from. Null for the baseline.

varied_channel.description: The channel a curve plan varies.

level.description: The factor of a curve plan.

multipliers.description: The factor or amount of each changed channel. Empty for the baseline.

mean.description: Total over the forecast. Null for a failed plan.

p05.description: The 5th percentile over draws, as a total.

p95.description: The 95th percentile over draws, as a total.

mean_difference.description: Paired mean difference from the base plan.

simulation_se.description: The Monte Carlo standard error of `mean_difference`.

draws_url.description: A signed link to the plan's draws file (netCDF4), or null.

ResultRow.description: One plan and one component, over the whole forecast.

id.description: Unique. `baseline` and the `curve:` prefix are reserved.

multipliers.description: A number from 0 to 5 multiplies the spend of a channel in the window. `{"amount": X}` sets its total. A channel left out keeps its spend.

value.description: The score of the mean line.

sd.description: The spread of the score over draws.

code.description: A stable code, for example `spend_outside_history_band`.

message.description: The same text as in `warnings`.

field.description: The channel or control the warning is about.

scenario.description: The plan id, for a warning of scope `scenario`.

WarningDetail.description: One warning as a structured object. The plain text is in ``warnings``.

WeeksForm.description:
The weeks form: the weeks of a stored dataset, with `context` and `query`. It takes no
`plan` and no `history`.

decision_weeks.description: `[i, j]`, 1-based and inclusive, in the plan or in the predicted weeks. Default: all of them.

explain_history.description: Default `true` for a backtest and `false` for a plan.

preview.description: `true` returns the expanded plans and stores nothing.

context.description: The input weeks of a backtest.

query.description: The last predicted week of a backtest.

channels.description: Channels of a backtest, at least one. Default: all.

controls.description: Controls of a backtest, at least one. Default: all.

bearerAuth.description: Your invitation tells you how to get your service URL and your key.
